assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson use the repository provisional polygons (official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint).
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, building footprints, phasing and metrics are provisional and must be recalculated when official polygons are supplied; they must not be used as official redline or precise-area basis.

assumptions.statement: building footprint, green/public space ratios and phasing are concept-level design quantities derived from the submitted geometry, not statutory FAR, height, density, setback or road-redline values.
assumptions.impact: These values are design estimates for presentation and discussion only; they do not constitute approved planning-control conditions.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test/validation scenarios, landmarks and operation mechanisms are concept suggestions or reference schemes proposed for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No scenario, event, funding, policy or operation arrangement is claimed as an approved government commitment or confirmed implementation.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, floors, heights, uses, ages, ownership and retain/renovate/demolish status are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal expresses renewal direction through concept footprints and flags parcel-level demolition/renovation conclusions as pending official data.
